remediation_items.title: Add Bhagat Singh: A Life in Revolution to Grand Library Portal
remediation_items.details: Registered full book metadata in libraryData.books array, created Certified BKRS Benchmarks showcase section with direct 3-view codex link, and added certified filter pill and badge.

remediation_items.title: Fix Source Trace drawer / overlay / reader layout CSS selector mismatches
remediation_items.details: Harmonized class selector aliases for source-trace-drawer, source-trace-overlay, reader-workspace, control-btn, view-tab-btn, and search-modal-box. Tested smooth drawer animation and backdrop clicks.

remediation_items.title: Add a clear user-facing entry point for the certified Cross-Book Synthesis layer
remediation_items.details: Generated interactive cross-book portal (105.8 KB) displaying 12 synthesis units, 14 canonical concepts, dialectical tensions, and quarantines with bidirectional links to Book Masters.

remediation_items.title: Add a concise epistemic legend explaining existing canonical epistemic labels
remediation_items.details: Injected topbar 'Guide' button and built responsive epistemic modal dialog defining 8 canonical truth-value categories with Escape key and backdrop dismissal.

remediation_items.title: Fix mobile reader topbar overflow at <=480px
remediation_items.details: Added responsive media queries for <=768px and <=480px, collapsed desktop text to clean icon controls, eliminated horizontal scrollbar, and maintained >=28px touch targets.

remediation_items.title: Make sidebar/TOC context-aware so View B and View C navigation does not reset to View A
remediation_items.details: Rendered view-specific sidebar navigation groups for Views A, B, and C across all 3 genres. Enhanced switchView() to toggle visible group and modified handleNavClick() to switch to parent view panel without blindly defaulting to View A.
